goal: Exercise Part A target resolution inside the merged extension
preamble: This practice runs on a Google Docs-shaped page served from the repo. Every target is resolved by Part A's resolver through the real teaching bridge. Try clicking Font during the Styles step to see the wrong-click path.
generalization: Part A resolved only visible controls, stripped platform shortcuts from toolbar labels, collapsed the nested Font size pair to one control, recognised the live Heading 1► row by its lesson-facing name, and verified outcomes from the toolbar readout and the document.

steps.intent: Click Font size. The toolbar contains two nested elements with that exact label, so the resolver must pick one stable control rather than fail as ambiguous.
hints: Use the number field that controls text size.
It is in the toolbar, immediately to the right of Arial.

wrongHints.Font: That is the typeface control. Use the number field immediately to its right.
wrongHints.Bold: Bold is a formatting toggle. Use the number field to the left of it.

steps.intent: Open the Styles dropdown. Its caption shows the current paragraph style, but the control is found by its aria-label.
hints: Open the control that changes what a paragraph is, not how it looks.
It is the first control on the left of the toolbar, showing 'Normal text'.

wrongHints.Font: That is the typeface control. Open Styles on the far left instead.
wrongHints.Font size: That changes only the numeric size. Open Styles on the far left instead.

steps.intent: Choose Heading 1. The live row reads 'Heading 1►' while the lesson names it Apply 'Heading 1', exactly like the hero lesson's step s4.
hints: Choose the first numbered heading level.
Third row of the open Styles menu, below Title.

wrongHints.Apply 'Title': Title is a different structural role. Choose Heading 1 instead.
wrongHints.Apply 'Normal text': Normal text is body copy. Choose Heading 1 instead.

steps.intent: Your turn, no highlight this time. Insert a table of contents. Have a look through the menus above the toolbar.
hints: You are adding something new to the document. Which menu handles that?

wrongHints.Insert: Good, that is the right menu. Now pick the item that builds a contents list from your headings.
